Description: Describes the columns of the listing of BIDS datasets. The Format of each column is described as python type. Missing values are null. The content of the .bidsignore file is not taken into account. Generated from bids_inventory.models.BidsDataset.

created_on.Description: Date of the first commit of the datalad dataset, for example 'Thu May 18 14:34:38 2023 +0000'.
created_on.Assumptions: The dataset may have been created or acquired long before it was turned into a datalad dataset.

nb_subjects.Description: Number of 'sub-*' folders in the dataset.
nb_subjects.Assumptions: Folders containing only non valid BIDS files will still be counted.

has_participant_tsv.Description: Whether the dataset has a 'participants.tsv' file.

has_participant_json.Description: Whether the dataset has a 'participants.json' file.

participant_columns.Description: Name of each column in the participants.tsv.

nb_sessions_tsv.Description: Total number of '*sessions.tsv' files in the dataset.

nb_scans_tsv.Description: Total number of '*scans.tsv' files in the dataset.

nb_physio_files.Description: Total number of '*physio.tsv.gz' files in the dataset.
nb_physio_files.Assumptions: Does not check if the name of files are BIDS valid.

nb_stim_files.Description: Total number of '*stim.tsv.gz' files in the dataset.
nb_stim_files.Assumptions: Does not check if the name of files are BIDS valid.

physio_recordings.Description: Labels of the recordings of the '*physio.tsv.gz' files (recording-<label>), for example eye1, cardiac, respiratory.
physio_recordings.Assumptions: Does not check if the name of files are BIDS valid.

physio_columns.Description: Columns of the physio files (Columns of their JSON sidecars), for example cardiac, respiratory, trigger.
physio_columns.Assumptions: Based on data from the first participant only.

has_phenotype_dir.Description: Whether the dataset has a 'phenotype' folder.

has_stimuli_dir.Description: Whether the dataset has a 'stimuli' folder.

eeg_file_formats.Description: Total number of EEG files of each BIDS supported file format.
eeg_file_formats.Assumptions: Does not check if the name of files are BIDS valid.

ieeg_file_formats.Description: Total number of iEEG files of each BIDS supported file format.
ieeg_file_formats.Assumptions: Does not check if the name of files are BIDS valid.

meg_file_formats.Description: Total number of MEG files of each BIDS supported file format.
meg_file_formats.Assumptions: Does not check if the name of files are BIDS valid.

nb_meeg_channels.Description: Number of EEG, iEEG or MEG channels. Read from the header where possible.
nb_meeg_channels.Assumptions: Based on data from the first participant only.

nb_channels.Description: Number of channels of each EEG, iEEG, MEG and EMG run, by datatype, from the JSON sidecars: EEGChannelCount, ECOGChannelCount + SEEGChannelCount, MEGChannelCount, EMGChannelCount.
nb_channels.Assumptions: Based on data from the first participant only.

datatypes.Description: List of BIDS supported datatypes found in the dataset.
datatypes.Assumptions: A datatype will be listed even if it occurs only in a single subject.

sessions.Assumptions: A session name will be listed even if it occurs only once for a single subject. The session will be listed even if it contains no valid BIDS file.

tasks.Description: List of the task names present in the dataset as they appear in filenames.
tasks.Assumptions: A task name will be listed even if it occurs only once for a single subject. The task will be listed even if it comes from a BIDS invalid filename.

size.Description: Size of the whole dataset as reported by 'datalad status --annex all'.
size.Assumptions: This includes all BIDS invalid files and the content of the derivatives and sourcedata folders. So likely to be an overestimation.

license.Description: Name of the license of the dataset.

authors.Description: List of the authors as reported in the dataset_description.json.

institutions.Description: List of the unique institutions found in the InstitutionName and InstitutionAddress of the JSON sidecars.
institutions.Assumptions: Based on the JSON sidecars in the root folder and of the first participant only.

field_strength.Description: List of the unique MagneticFieldStrength (in Tesla) found in the JSON sidecars.
field_strength.Assumptions: Based on the JSON sidecars in the root folder and of the first participant only.

bids_version.Description: BIDSVersion in the dataset_description.json of the dataset.

duration.Description: Duration of each run, as (number of samples, duration of a sample in seconds): the number of volumes and the repetition time for fMRI and PET, the number of samples and 1 / sampling frequency for EEG and iEEG, or (1, duration in seconds) when read from the JSON sidecar (RecordingDuration for EEG, iEEG, MEG, NIRS, motion and EMG, sum of FrameDuration for PET). Listed by datatype and where possible split further by task. (0, NaN) if the duration of a run could not be read.
duration.Format: dict[str, list[tuple[int, float]] | dict[str, list[tuple[int, float]]]]
duration.Assumptions: Based on data from the first participant only: assumes that all participants followed the same protocol.

readme_size.Description: Size (in bytes) of the README of the dataset (README, README.md, README.txt or README.rst), None if it has none.

bidsignore_size.Description: Size (in bytes) of the .bidsignore of the dataset, None if it has none.

references_and_links.Description: List of the ReferencesAndLinks of the dataset_description.json.

hed_version.Description: HEDVersion of the dataset_description.json, as a list (the standard schema and the library schemas).

cog_atlas_id.Description: CogAtlasID of each task (Cognitive Atlas), from the JSON sidecars of its runs.
cog_atlas_id.Assumptions: Based on data from the first participant only.

cogpo_id.Description: CogPOID of each task (Cognitive Paradigm Ontology), from the JSON sidecars of its runs.
cogpo_id.Assumptions: Based on data from the first participant only.

fmriprep.Description: Link to the fMRIPrep dataset in the derivatives folder of the dataset or on OpenNeuroDerivatives. null if it does not exist.

freesurfer.Description: Link to the FreeSurfer dataset in the derivatives folder of the dataset or on OpenNeuroDerivatives. null if it does not exist.

mriqc.Description: Link to the MRIQC dataset in the derivatives folder of the dataset or on OpenNeuroDerivatives. null if it does not exist.

fmriprep_version.Description: Version of fMRIPrep that generated the 'fmriprep' derivative dataset, from 'GeneratedBy' (or 'PipelineDescription') in its dataset_description.json. null if there is no such derivative dataset or if the version is not recorded.

freesurfer_version.Description: Version of FreeSurfer that generated the 'freesurfer' derivative dataset, from 'GeneratedBy' (or 'PipelineDescription') in its dataset_description.json. null if there is no such derivative dataset or if the version is not recorded.

mriqc_version.Description: Version of MRIQC that generated the 'mriqc' derivative dataset, from 'GeneratedBy' (or 'PipelineDescription') in its dataset_description.json. null if there is no such derivative dataset or if the version is not recorded.
